page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture general-purpose server powered by the AMD EPYC 9T24 processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the top tier for memory performance, with a Passmark memory score in the top 10% and cached read-only memory bandwidth reaching 3647.99 GB/sec. CPU performance is consistently strong, scoring in the top 25% across single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU suites. It demonstrates robust capabilities in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (260.82 GB/sec) and software compilation (47874.0 on Geekbench clang). However, uncached large-block memory read and write speeds, alongside static web serving throughput, fall into the average category.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8a.12xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage for disk-heavy operations. This server is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching layers (achieving 64.56 million SET operations per second), software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
